function inspectMethod(value: () => void) {
  const { toString } = value;
  const { toString: method = () => '' } = value;
  const { ['toString']: computed } = value;
  return [typeof toString, method === Function.prototype.toString, computed === toString];
}
console.log(...inspectMethod(() => {}));
function nestedParameter({ holder: [{ toString: method }] }: { holder: [() => void] }) {
  return typeof method;
}
function inspectNested(fn: () => void) {
  const { holder: { toString: fromObject } } = { holder: fn };
  const [{ toString: fromArray = () => '' }] = [fn];
  var [{ toString: fromVar }] = [fn];
  return [typeof fromObject, fromArray === fromVar, nestedParameter({ holder: [fn] })];
}
console.log(...inspectNested(() => {}));
for (const [{ toString: method }] of [[() => {}]]) console.log(typeof method);
function inspectVar(fn: () => void) {
  var direct: () => string;
  {
    var direct = fn.toString;
  }
  var { toString: extracted } = fn;
  return [typeof direct, extracted === direct];
}
console.log(...inspectVar(() => {}));
function inspectQueried(fn: () => void) {
  type Method = typeof fn.toString;
  const { toString: method } = fn;
  var direct = (fn.toString as Method);
  type Extracted = typeof method;
  type Direct = typeof direct;
  interface Info { fromQuery: typeof direct }
  function compare(arg: Extracted): boolean {
    return (method as Extracted) === arg;
  }
  return [compare(() => ''), typeof method!, typeof (<Info["fromQuery"]>direct)];
}
console.log(...inspectQueried(() => {}));
